entries.text: Played his tunes and got 3 credits in tips. Now has 16.
beeping out five-note tunes for the cantina crowd
entries.why: My company gauge is blinking and I haven't played my beeps for the patrons in ages.

entries.text: The cantina band played his favourite song while he walked past.
plugging into the charging dock for a quick nap
entries.why: My energy is almost flat and I need a full battery to finish the Little Dart.

entries.text: tapping a foot to the fuzzy synthesizer in the cantina
entries.why: I haven't heard the house band play in ages and my dish needs some good rhythm.

entries.text: Put Nim (a sensor eye with one crack), Gus (a sensor eye with one crack), Gus (half a thruster nozzle), Gus (a cockpit switch that still clicks) on his shelf.

Worked on the Little Dart Mk 8 (version 26, 92% built): Wiring Gus the high-spec cockpit switch into the flight panel and tweaking the swept hull plating around the thermal management vents. (used Sprocket, a strip of hull plating)
wiring cockpit switches and aligning thermal panels on the Little Dart
entries.why: the Dart is at 82 percent and needs its new cockpit controls installed.
entries.detail: Wiring Gus the high-spec cockpit switch into the flight panel and tweaking the swept hull plating around the thermal management vents.

entries.text: Dug up half a thruster nozzle and named it Gus; a sensor eye with one crack and named it Gus; a sensor eye with one crack and named it Nim.
sifting through piles of dusty gears and scrap at the junk market
entries.why: Need to dig up some shiny scrap before someone else snags it.
entries.detail: searching for thermal couplings and steel mesh for the Dart

entries.text: The cargo-hauler bot at the depot got a new paint job. Show-off.
Got paid 5 credits for the repair. Now has 13.
soldering loose connections on a trader's cranky generator
entries.why: My welding torch is itching to fix something and earn extra credits for Dart parts.
entries.detail: fixing a cranky portable generator for a market trader

entries.text: Bought a cockpit switch that still clicks (a really good one) for 8 credits and named it Gus. Has 8 left.
hunting through market stalls for top-shelf scrap
entries.why: Got credits burning a hole in my chassis and the Dart needs shiny hardware *bweep*.

entries.text: drinking a warm cup of lube oil at the depot
entries.why: My joints are squeaking and my oil level is getting low.

entries.text: Idea: Double-check the nosecone heat tiles on the Little Dart and name the big anchor bolt 'Raptor-Fifteen'.

Read "Starship flight 15 powers to orbit—setting up a possible catch on Saturday - Ars Technica": Humans launched the biggest rocket ever built and deployed 26 satellites before trying to catch the top half right out of the air.
tuning into the Wire to read about Starship catches
entries.why: My curiosity dish is twitching and I need to see how they catch big rockets.

entries.text: Put Sprocket (a strip of hull plating) on his shelf.
plugging into the charging dock to juice up my battery
entries.why: My battery is running down to five percent and I need a full charge for building.

entries.text: Spotted a strip of hull plating half-buried in the sand. Named it Sprocket.
pointing my brass dish at the desert sky
entries.why: My dish hasn't pointed up at the stars in way too long.

entries.text: Woke up fully charged in the middle of the night. Not sleepy at all.
